title: an install check measures that a spawn interpreter imports what its caller imports
intention: A registered install-inspector check reds a box whose spawn interpreter (background_python()) does not share its caller's site-packages, naming the interpreter and the prefix each reports.
why: Measured 2026-11-12 on akiendell: background_python() returned the base interpreter, not the venv, and a child died at import psycopg2 (bus.log); fixed in bfbfe42a7
traces_to: Law 3: an install is not known until measured. Law 4: install facts are enforced by an inspector, not remembered.
how: Once the install inspector exists (bdd0ed77930f), add check_spawn_interpreter(dry_run) in the Recovery installer shaped {id,status,detail}: run background_python() with -c 'import sys; print(sys.prefix)' and compare with sys.prefix; register it in CHECKS. The red-first proof feeds a runner stub that reports a different prefix.

clauses.claim: a stub spawn interpreter reporting a prefix different from the caller's makes the check return offered, naming both prefixes
a spawn interpreter reporting the caller's own prefix returns already_applied

decisions.text: D1: the fix at cairn/devices/recovery/machines/installer/installer.py The inspector's CHECKS gains the registration string (how: 'register it in CHECKS').
D2: one proof, one tooth per clause; red first.

measured.saw: background_python() returned the base interpreter, not the venv, and a child died at import psycopg2 (bus.log); fixed in bfbfe42a7
measured.how: background_python() run with -c 'import sys; print(sys.prefix)' compared with the venv's sys.prefix; recorded in ticket bdd0ed77930f's measured

orient.request: 404f193284ac: an install check measures that a spawn interpreter imports what its caller imports
orient.intent: A registered install-inspector check, check_spawn_interpreter, reds a box whose spawn interpreter (background_python()) does not report its caller's sys.prefix, naming the interpreter and both prefixes.
orient.scope: the installer's new check, its one registration line in the inspector's CHECKS, and one proof; the interpreter helper is read, never written
unknowns: a real second interpreter with a different prefix was not run: the proof injects the run seam, and the live check on this box answers already_applied
the posix side was not run on the Windows box where the build was made

constraints.text: Nothing is known until measured. An unmeasured claim is a hypothesis and is labeled as one.
Nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build couldn't pass.

holdings.what: the install inspector and its CHECKS

absences.measure: git grep -c check_spawn_interpreter HEAD -- cairn/devices/recovery answers 0 (before the build)

sub_problems.what: check_spawn_interpreter with injectable run, python and caller_prefix, registered in CHECKS, and a two-tooth red-first proof
sub_problems.why: a child spawned with the base interpreter died at import psycopg2 and nothing on the box said so beforehand

order.what: check_spawn_interpreter with injectable run, python and caller_prefix, registered in CHECKS, and a two-tooth red-first proof
order.why_now: built locally: red first (both teeth AttributeError), then green twice on Windows

hypotheses.piece: check_spawn_interpreter with injectable run, python and caller_prefix, registered in CHECKS, and a two-tooth red-first proof
hypotheses.expect: 2 teeth green twice, and the installer and inspector proofs unchanged
hypotheses.falsifier: a different prefix does not return offered naming both, or the caller's own prefix is not already_applied, or the check is absent from CHECKS

covers: check_spawn_interpreter with injectable run, python and caller_prefix, registered in CHECKS, and a two-tooth red-first proof
